translator.model_source: read from the translation lane's own translator.log model-switch lines; not observed live by this auditor
translator.independence_disclosure: the translator lane and this audit run ended on the same underlying model (radient/auto) through the same provider quota fallback; independence here is by agent and session, not by model, and is disclosed rather than claimed.

auditor.actual_model_source: harness session header (model-switch notices): primary anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 failed on quota and fell back openai/gpt-6-astra -> kimi/k3.1-pro -> radient/auto; what radient/auto resolves to upstream is not visible from this session

findings.problem: 'organizing agent' is rendered व्यवस्थापक (administrator/manager), which names a different function from organising the catalogue; the same roster also lists a Manager agent, so the two roles read closer than the source makes them.
findings.suggestion: लाइब्रेरी को व्यवस्थित करने वाला एजेंट: … (or लाइब्रेरी का संयोजक एजेंट), rest unchanged

findings.problem: 'AI-isms' means AI-flavoured writing tells; the Hindi says 'AI-like artificial things', dropping the writing object, while every other criterion in that list is a property of the text.
findings.suggestion: …और AI जैसी बनावटी भाषा (or …और AI की पहचान देने वाली घिसी-पिटी बातें)

findings.problem: ड़ carries no nukta (ढूँढ़ता), against the hi style guide's binding nukta rule. The catalogue's only other use, ui.teamBridge.create.channel_description ('ढूँढकर'), has the same defect, so a fix should cover both.
findings.suggestion: खामियाँ ढूँढ़ता है — or the everyday खामियाँ खोजता है, which sidesteps the orthography

findings.current: आपकी ओर से एजेंट और टीमें चलाती हैं
findings.problem: The object has no को, so the clause can be read with एजेंट और टीमें as subject ('agents and teams run on your behalf') instead of the thing she runs; the following clauses resolve it, but a card is read at a glance.
findings.suggestion: आपकी ओर से एजेंटों और टीमों को चलाती हैं

findings.current: स्रोत के बजाय रेंडर किए गए फ़्रेम से
findings.problem: The English verb ('judged') has no Hindi counterpart, so the comparison hangs off the noun phrase and फ़्रेम से is a thin instrument.
findings.suggestion: स्रोत के बजाय रेंडर किए गए फ़्रेम के आधार पर

findings.problem: Flattens 'keyboard-first' to 'keyboard-driven'; the priority claim (the keyboard decides the design) is lost.

findings.current: चलाती हैं … नज़र रखती हैं … बताती हैं
findings.problem: Honorific plural, while every other agent in the same list is plain singular (करता है). It reads as deliberate persona warmth — the sidecar asks for a warm register — but it is a register split inside one roster.
findings.suggestion: No change required if deliberate; align to चलाती है … रखती है … बताती है if the roster should read uniformly
